text_block_list.text:
Senior Classâthe spring Gâ campaign is 
fast approaching.
Then, one night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I even be aiming for in 
the end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What do I want to do? What do I want to 
become...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like there's actually another one. 
But I can't see it... Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I was thinking about my goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This past year... no, from this year on 
out, what should I even be running for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to find an answer soon. I have a 
general sense of the direction, though.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that direction?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With a thoroughly trained body, I want to 
become an Umamusume capable of surpassing 
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That is fine. Even though that was the 
only thing I was supposed to be aiming 
for...

She doesn't look very relieved. It seems 
she has something on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah! This is the right way, isn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I work hard and surpass McQueen, I'll 
be fully satisfied! ...At least, I should 
be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...No way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Why... How do you know that...? Something 
like that...

Her expression looked as if a sore spot 
had been hit. The roots of Mejiro Ryan's 
admiration might run even deeper than I 
thought.

"Why did you look up to McQueen?" When 
asked that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Because McQueen is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"She was always beautiful... Pure and 
dignified, no matter where she was..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Just her being there changed the whole 
atmosphere... Like we stepped into another 
world entirely..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And... she was always surrounded by so 
many people. Loved by people beyond her 
family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanted to become a star—just like that!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Me... a Star Umamusume? Just like 
Oguri-san and McQueen...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Acting like such a fangirl! Knowing 
no shame...!
choice_data_list: Still, that's what you want to be, right?
Still, that's what you want to be, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes... I want... to become one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating and embarrassing to admit 
something like this. But... I want to 
become a star Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And... I don't even know how to become 
one...

Having poured her heart out, Mejiro Ryan 
calmed down a little. We talk as we walk 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what does it really mean to have 
"star quality"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is so glamorous, and Oguri-san's 
races are always so dramatic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's not just looks. It's not just speed. 
Then... what is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way~. Even you don't know, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still... I suppose that's just how things 
are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else has that 'special 
something,' and that's the one thing hard 
work alone can't buy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's just me asking for the impossible, 
but... I'm glad to know how you truly 
feel."

Mejiro Ryan smiled wistfully, carrying a 
question far too heavy for her young 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, even I'm surprised by it... I can 
be pathetic and childish at times, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to continuing to work with 
you.

Senior Class. Even as she grows clutch in 
high-stakes races, Mejiro Ryan's heart 
remains that of a young maiden.

However—a harsh spring will not wait. She 
has no choice but to run through it, 
carrying her fragility.
